sound-boat-help: Hear the picture word. Add one box for each sound, then tap Load letters. Pick the letters for each empty box. Two letters can make one sound, like sh. In a ladder, keep the sounds that stay the same. A line under a vowel means silent e, as in a_e. Together, one person counts and says the sounds; the other loads letters. Swap jobs for the next word. Take turns: a rung without a hint or retry earns a point. There is no clock.
sound-boat-letters: Load the letters for each empty sound box. Keep the sounds that stay the same.
sound-boat-sail: You built the word. Sail to the next word when you are ready.

turtle-tales-help: Tap each word in order as you read it. The turtle takes one step per word. The ear beside the next word speaks just that word. Read it to me first models this page once. When you finish the page, the picture comes alive. Look for two pictures from the story at the end. Together, take turns reading each sentence. Go at your own pace.
turtle-tales-look: One word changed. Look at that word and try again.
turtle-tales-next-word: The turtle is waiting at the warm word. Read that word next.
turtle-tales-read: Read and tap each word in order. The little ear can help with the next word.
